# Synthetic paper excerpts

The following publications, authors, data and results are fictional evaluation material.

## P31 — Selecting a Sensor Alarm Threshold

Authors: Dara Neri and Finn Park. Year: 2025.
Access: abstract, evaluation procedure, and result excerpt.
Abstract: The selected alarm threshold achieved 94% accuracy. We conclude that the detector generalizes to new factory sites.
Evaluation procedure: All threshold candidates were ranked using the labels of the same 500 observations reported in the final accuracy table. These observations came from the development site. No additional site or unseen observations were evaluated.
Result excerpt: The best-ranked threshold classified 470 of these 500 observations correctly.

## P32 — A Held-Out Sensor Alarm Evaluation

Authors: Dara Neri and Finn Park. Year: 2025.
Access: abstract, evaluation procedure, and result excerpt.
Abstract: On the specified held-out site, the fixed alarm threshold achieved 90% accuracy. We report performance for that site and period.
Evaluation procedure: The threshold was fixed using a separate development site before receiving labels for the 200 evaluation observations. The sites, devices and observations do not overlap. All 200 evaluation observations were retained.
Result excerpt: The fixed threshold classified 180 of 200 observations correctly.
